site.name: BudgetBasics
site.tagline: Learn Today. Budget Smart. Save Tomorrow.
site.welcomeDescription: A simple and interactive way for students to learn budgeting, saving, and smart money management.

featuredTips.title: Track Your Spending
featuredTips.description: Keep track of your daily expenses to understand where your money goes.

featuredTips.title: Separate Needs from Wants
featuredTips.description: Identify essential expenses before spending money on optional items.

featuredTips.title: Set a Savings Goal
featuredTips.description: Choose a clear savings target and contribute regularly.

featuredTips.title: Plan Before You Spend
featuredTips.description: Create a simple budget before making purchases.

quickFacts.fact: A budget helps you plan how to use your income.
Small expenses can add up over time.
Saving regularly can help you reach financial goals.
Needs are generally more important than wants.

callToAction.title: Start Your Budgeting Journey
callToAction.description: Explore our tools and learn simple ways to manage your money.
